# JB Software Solutions

> JB Software Solutions is a custom software development company in India offering web development, mobile app development (Flutter and React Native), desktop apps (Electron and Tauri), custom CRM/ERP software, technical SEO, AEO, GEO / LLM SEO, and workflow automation for startups and growing businesses.

- Brand: JB Software Solutions

## Services

- [Ai Automation](https://jbsoftwaresolutions.com/services/ai-automation/): Business workflow and process automation across CRM, leads, follow-ups and ops tools.
- [Custom Software](https://jbsoftwaresolutions.com/services/custom-software/): Custom CRM, ERP, SaaS and internal tool development with IP handover.
- [Desktop Apps](https://jbsoftwaresolutions.com/services/desktop-apps/): Electron and Tauri desktop app development for offline and hardware-heavy tools.
- [Mobile App Development](https://jbsoftwaresolutions.com/services/mobile-app-development/): Flutter and React Native mobile app development for Android and iOS.
- [Seo Aeo Geo](https://jbsoftwaresolutions.com/services/seo-aeo-geo/): Technical SEO, AEO and Generative Engine Optimization for Google and ChatGPT citations.
- [Web Development](https://jbsoftwaresolutions.com/services/web-development/): Next.js and React web development with SEO foundations.
